book.page:
WOULD YOU LIKE A STARAPPLE, FRIEND?
THEY ARE LOVELY. THE JUICE IS INSIDE.
OH, MYSELF? HAH HAH HAH. NO, FRIEND. I WON'T BE EATING ONE.
I COULDN'T.
MUST I, ANYWAY, TO APPRECIATE THE JUICE?
CAN'T I ADMIRE THE AESTHETICS OF THE APPLE FROM AFAR?
AREN'T I IN A BETTER POSITION TO JUDGE THE APPLE, ABSTAINING FROM THE JUICE, AS I DO?
HAH HAH HAH, FRIEND!
I ENJOY OUR CONVERSATIONS.
THERE, THE HIGH SALT SUN! IT CASTS NEXT TO NO SHADOWS.
BUT SOON IT WILL TRACE AN ARC ALONG THE WIDE SKY.
AND THEN, WHY, WOULD YOU SIT WITH ME? IN THE SHADE OF A STARAPPLE TREE.
YOU MAY EAT A STARAPPLE WHILE YOU DO. THE JUICE IS INSIDE.
